messages:
maria_support: Elena from Acme reports intermittent 502/504s on /v1/embeddings since ~10:15 UTC. Customer says SDK retries doubled billing. Request id: req_9a7f2c. @sam_oncall can you triage? cc @infra_sre
elena_acme: Posting sample curl + response. Happens with default node SDK, concurrency ~40. We see sequence: 200,200,502,504,200. Very bursty.
elena_acme: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input": ["a","b","c"]}'```
Response snippet: {"error":"gateway timeout","status":504,"request_id":"req_9a7f2c"}
deploy-bot: Alert: 5xx spike on embeddings-prod (10:14-10:22 UTC) -> 420 5xxs, p95 latency 1.8s, queue depth +120 (alert id a-4821) :rotating_light:
sam_oncall: I'll pull gateway logs and proxy queue metrics. Can you share SDK version + exact repro? @maria_support
maria_support: Customer on node SDK 0.7.2. Repro script attached (short). Also seeing duplicate charging events flagged by billing.
maria_support: ```// repro snippet
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY)
await Promise.all(new Array(40).fill(0).map(()=>client.embeddings.create({model:'embed-base',input:['a','b']})))```
infra_sre: Looking at ingress: at 10:18 we hit an internal conn limit on edge pool eu-west-1-gw-3, backend pods healthy. Proxy started returning 502 due to conn overflow -> 504s from upstream timeouts.
sam_oncall: Hypothesis: high concurrent connections + short idle timeout on customer side leads to connection churn and proxy head-of-line blocking. Suggest workaround: enable HTTP keepalive pooling in SDK v0.9.7 (fix: reuse sockets) or reduce concurrency.
sam_oncall: Short-term mitigation deployed: increased edge conn limit by 20% for eu-west-1 and backpressure to return 429 instead of 502 when queue > 80 to avoid billing-retry loops. Rolling now.
maria_support: Can we get a patch note text for customer? Also need confirmation that billing won't double-charge them.
infra_sre: Billing system debits on successful responses only. Retries that get 5xx won't create new charge events, but duplicate downstream receipts from SDK retry could double count if SDK replays without idempotency. We'll audit request ids and tag the group for manual review (req_9a7f2c).
sam_oncall: Logs show many retries lacked idempotency keys. Recommend customers set `Idempotency-Key` header for embeddings in high-concurrency scenarios; SDK v0.9.7 will auto-add when user passes an array batch.
maria_support: Drafting customer update: short apology + steps. @elena_acme do you want me to send now? Proposed message: "We're investigating; temporary workaround: upgrade SDK to v0.9.7 and set max concurrency to 20 or enable keepalive pooling. We deployed edge mitigation; please share repro if persists."
elena_acme: Please send. We'll try the upgrade and report back in 30m. Thanks.
sam_oncall: I'll follow up with a short post-mortem if we see recurrence. Adding backlog task: make 429 backpressure behavior global and enable SDK idempotency by default. :memo:
